title: Bruce Henderson
content: # Bruce Henderson. | Known for | Founder of Boston Consulting Group |. **Bruce Doolin Henderson** (April 30, 1915 – July 20, 1992) was an American businessman and management expert. He founded Boston Consulting Group (BCG) in 1963 in Boston, Massachusetts and headed the firm as the president and CEO until 1980. Henderson was born on a farm in Nashville, Tennessee on April 30, 1915. In the fourth grade, he enrolled in the Peabody Demonstration School (PDS) and remained there until his high school graduation in 1932. Henderson had seven grandchildren at the time of his death. Little, Henderson accepted a challenge from the CEO of Boston Company to create a consulting arm for the bank, operating as a subsidiary under the name Management and Consulting Division of the Boston Safe Deposit and Trust Company. Henderson stepped down from his role as the president and CEO of Boston Consulting Group in 1980.

title: BCG History - The History of Boston Consulting Group
content: BCG began not as another management consulting firm but as a pioneer of bold, new approaches to running a company. One of the many legacies left by Bruce Henderson, BCG’s founder, is the importance of always challenging the status quo. ## Bruce Henderson’s Ideas and BCG Perspectives. From the beginning, Bruce Henderson’s passion for ideas was the firm’s mark of distinction. His ideas and writings reveal a visionary who excelled at challenging the status quo, a brilliant thinker, and a man of action, driven by a strong sense of purpose. In 1964 he developed a new approach to marketing a consulting firm: *Perspectives*, brief and highly provocative essays on strategy. The concept of time-based competition, first introduced by BCG in the 1980s, is a demonstration of the power of time management. When Bruce Henderson founded BCG, he envisioned that it might someday change the world. With true insight and the ability to transform it into action, BCG has driven real change in organizations and fulfilled Henderson’s vision.

title: Profile of Boston Consulting Group
content: ## The Top Global Consulting Firms >. # Profile of Boston Consulting Group. Boston Consulting Group Overview, Profile, and History. **Boston Consulting Group** **(BCG)** is one of the world’s leading management consulting firms, renowned for its pioneering strategy work and influential business frameworks. Henderson, BCG began as a bold new approach to corporate consulting, focusing on business strategy as its specialty​. Over six decades, the firm has grown into a global partnership with tens of thousands of consultants, known for helping organizations solve complex problems and gain competitive advantage​. ## History and Growth of BCG. BCG was established in 1963 as the management consulting division of the Boston Safe Deposit and Trust Company by Bruce D. In 1969 the unit was officially named Boston Consulting Group, reflecting Henderson’s vision of a collegial partnership. Notably, a group of BCG consultants led by Bill Bain left in 1973 to form Bain & Company, another major strategy firm, but BCG continued to thrive on its own.
